<?php
class Base164Author {}
trait Trait164Author {
    public static function stop(?parent $value = null): never {
        echo 'body:', self::class, ':', static::class, ';';
    }
    public const array Y = [self::stop(...)];
    public static array $x = self::Y;
}
trait Layer164Author { use Trait164Author; }
set_error_handler(static function () { return true; });
class First164Author extends Base164Author {
    use Layer164Author;
    public static array $x = self::Y;
}
$old = First164Author::Y[0];
$old = clone $old;
class Later164Author extends Base164Author {
    use Layer164Author;
    public static array $x = self::Y;
}
$later = Later164Author::Y[0];
try { $old(); } catch (TypeError $e) {
    echo 'old:', $e->getMessage(), ':', $e->getLine(), ';';
}
try { $later(); } catch (TypeError $e) {
    echo 'later:', $e->getMessage(), ':', $e->getLine(), ';';
}

<?php
class Base164ReviewA {}
class Alt164ReviewA {}
trait Trait164ReviewA {
    public static function receive(Alt164ReviewA|parent $value): string {
        echo 'body:', self::class, ':', static::class, ';';
        return 'ok';
    }
    public const array Y = [self::receive(...)];
    public static array $x = self::Y;
}
trait Layer164ReviewA { use Trait164ReviewA; }
set_error_handler(static function () { return true; });
class First164ReviewA extends Base164ReviewA {
    use Layer164ReviewA;
    public static array $x = self::Y;
}
$old = First164ReviewA::Y[0];
$old = clone $old;
class Later164ReviewA extends Base164ReviewA {
    use Layer164ReviewA;
    public static array $x = self::Y;
}
$later = Later164ReviewA::Y[0];
echo 'old:', $old(new Alt164ReviewA), ';';
echo 'later:', $later(new Base164ReviewA), ';';
